title: Deirfiúracha na gaiscíochta
description: Tá buaiceanna dornálaíochta an domhain sroichte ag Lisa agus Aoife O’Rourke
content:
Ceithre bliana ó shin, ar an 24 Bealtaine 2022, bhí bean as Ros Comáin, Lisa O’Rourke, i bPáirc an Chrócaigh mar aoi speisialta nuair a seoladh Craobhchomórtas TG4 i bPeil na mBan. Bhí an dornálaí tar éis bonn óir a bhuachan sna Craobhacha Domhanda cúpla seachtain roimhe sin. Bhain peileadóirí Ros Comáin ardú céime amach sa pheil ag tús mhí Aibreáin nuair a bhuaigh siad cluiche ceannais Roinn 3 den tSraith Náisiúnta Peile.
Duine díograiseach, fuinniúil agus umhal is ea í. Labhair sí go hoscailte ag an seoladh sin agus thug sí léargas ar shaol an lúthchleasaí agus ar a cuid spriocanna pearsanta. Bhí an pheil Ghaelach fós ina cuid thábhachtach de shaol Lisa ar feadh tamaill. D’imir sí i lár na páirce ar fhoireann Ros Comáin. Féilire spóirt lán d’imeachtaí, traenáil agus cluichí ag teacht salach ar a chéile. Ba dheacair an dá thrá a fhreastal ach d’éirigh léi a bheith ag imirt peil idirchontae agus a bheith i mbun dornálaíochta ag an am céanna.
Anois, tá clú agus cáil uirthi agus í ag dornálaíocht ar fud an domhain. Bhí ríméad ar lucht leanúna Lisa nuair a rinne sí éacht arís i gCraobhchomórtas na hEorpa coicís ó shin agus bonn óir eile buaite aici sa troid 80kg. Ní hamháin sin, ach dhá lá ina dhiaidh sin, bhuaigh a deirfiúr, Aoife, an bonn óir sa troid 75kg.
Tá Lisa O’Rourke, 24 bliana d’aois, ar dhuine de na dornálaithe óga is rathúla in Éirinn faoi láthair. Is as an gCaisleán Riabhach i gContae Ros Comáin di agus is ball de chlub dornálaíochta an bhaile í.
Tá iomrá mór ar a deirfiúr Aoife, atá 29 mbliana d’aois, ar an ardán idirnáisiúnta freisin. Is dornálaí den scoth í Aoife a bhí ina curadh domhanda agus ina curadh Eorpach cúpla uair.
D’fhás Lisa agus Aoife aníos ar fheirm an teaghlaigh agus ba mhinic a bhídís ag cabhrú lena n-athair, Kevin, leis an obair feirme…
Níor thosaigh Lisa ná Aoife amach ag brionglóideach faoi ghairm sa dornálaíocht. D’fhás an grá don spórt ar bhealach níos nádúrtha. Bhí Aoife ag imirt peil Ghaelach agus chuaigh sí isteach i gclub dornálaíochta sa Chaisleán Riabhach chun tuilleadh traenála a dhéanamh agus le bheith níos aclaí don pheil. Spreag sí Lisa le triail a bhaint as an dornálaíocht freisin agus cé go raibh Lisa beagáinín drogallach ar dtús, thosaigh an bheirt ag traenáil le chéile agus níorbh fhada go raibh siad ag cruthú go láidir sa dornálaíocht.
D’fhás Lisa agus Aoife aníos ar fheirm an teaghlaigh agus ba mhinic a bhídís ag cabhrú lena n-athair, Kevin, leis an obair feirme, go háirithe le linn an earraigh leis na huain óga agus na laonna. Obair chrua fhisiciúil a bhí i gceist agus d’fhéadfá a rá gur chabhraigh sé seo leo san fháinne dornálaíochta.
Tháinig an chéad mhór-rath idirnáisiúnta a bhí ag Lisa nuair a bhuaigh sí bonn óir ag Craobhchomórtais na hEorpa Faoi 22 in 2022. Ní raibh sí fiú tar éis craobh shinsearach na hÉireann a bhuachan ag an bpointe sin, ach níor chuir sé sin stop léi bogadh ar aghaidh chuig an leibhéal is airde. Níos déanaí an bhliain sin, bhain sí éacht amach sa Tuirc nuair a bhuaigh sí bonn óir ag Craobh an Domhain sa rannóg 70kg. Bhuail sí Alcinda Panguane as Mósaimbíc sa chluiche ceannais. In 2024, bhuaigh Lisa bonn óir eile ag Craobh na hEorpa Faoi 22 agus in 2025 bhí sí ar ais i gcluiche ceannais Chraobh an Domhain, áit ar bhuaigh sí bonn airgid.
Ba mhór an dúshlán a cuireadh roimpi ina dhiaidh sin. Bhris sí cnámh ina lámh agus b’éigean di dul faoi scian. Bhí uirthi fanacht as an bhfáinne ar feadh tréimhse fhada fad is a bhí a lámh ag cneasú. Bhí sí as an iomaíocht ar feadh bliana nó mar sin, ach d’oibrigh sí go dian le filleadh ar an leibhéal is airde. Údar dóchais a bhí ann agus é cinntithe go mbeadh Lisa san iomaíocht ag Craobhchomórtais Shinsearacha na hEorpa sa Bhulgáir coicís ó shin. Chuir sí tús láidir leis an gcomórtas agus bhuaigh sí ceithre throid as a chéile! Bhuail sí Vasiliki Stavridou na Gréige, Emily Asquith Shasana agus Iryna Lutsak ar a bealach chuig an gcluiche ceannais.Sa chluiche ceannais an 24 Meán Fómhair, thug Lisa aghaidh ar Anastasiia Demurchian na Rúise, curadh domhanda 2023. Bhuaigh bean Ros Comáin ar chinneadh scoilte 4-1 chun bonn óir na hEorpa a bhaint amach sa chatagóir 80kg. Mar sin, tá sí anois ina curadh domhanda agus ina curadh Eorpach sinsearach.
Tá scéal Aoife chomh suntasach céanna. Thosaigh Aoife ag dornálaíocht nuair a bhí sí thart ar 17 mbliana d’aois. Bhí sí fós ag imirt peile le Ros Comáin ag an am ach stop sí tamall ina dhiaidh sin le díriú ar an bhfáinne dornálaíochta. Bhí sí ina curadh Eorpach in 2019, 2022 agus 2024, agus bhuaigh sí bonn óir ag Craobh an Domhain in 2025. Bhí Aoife san iomaíocht ag na Cluichí Oilimpeacha i dTóiceo agus i bPáras freisin agus, coicís ó shin, dhá lá i ndiaidh dá deirfiúr bonn óir a bhuachaint, bhuaigh sí féin an bonn óir freisin i gCraobhacha na hEorpa.
Ócáid ar leith a bhí ann i stair na dornálaíochta leis an mbeirt deirfiúracha ag troid agus ag buachaint sna cluichí ceannais sa chomórtas céanna. B’iontach an toradh a bhí ar a gcuid oibre agus ar a gcumas. D’éirigh laoch na dornálaíochta, Katie Taylor, as an spórt ag tús na míosa ach is cinnte go bhfuil an spórt agus dornálaithe na hÉireann ag dul ó neart go neart. Tá ardmholadh tuillte ag Lisa agus Aoife, beirt lúthchleasaithe a thosaigh a n-aistear ar pháirceanna feirme i Ros Comáin agus a chuaigh ar aghaidh go páirceanna peile na tíre agus ansin chuig na hardáin is mó sa dornálaíocht.

title: Idir dóchas agus díle
description: Tá rás na huachtaránachta faoi lán seoil sa Fhrainc i láthair na huaire
content:
“ Après nous, le déluge ” (“Inár ndiaidh, an díle”), arsa Madame de Pompadour chun sólás a thabhairt dá leannán, an rí absalóideach Louis XV.
Ní poblacht absalóideach é córas uachtaránachta 5ú République na Fraince, a bhunaigh Charles de Gaulle in 1958, ach is briseadh é leis an gcóras parlaiminteach a bhí ann roimhe.
Nuair a bhunaigh Emmanuel Macron gluaiseacht pholaitiúil nua, En Marche (Renaissance ó 2022 i leith), agus nuair a bhuaigh sé toghchán na huachtaránachta in 2017, ní hamháin gur briseadh greim seanbhunaithe páirtithe an láir, na heite clé agus na heite deise, ach neartaíodh na páirtithe foircneacha ar na himill freisin.
In 2017 bhí beirt seanadóirí agus ochtar teachtaí parlaiminte ag an Rassemblement National (RN, nó Front National mar a bhí ag an am), páirtí na heite fíordheise. Toghadh seanadóirí nua de chuid an RN le déanaí agus is grúpa ar leith sa Seanad anois iad, 15 as 346 san iomlán, mar aon leis na 126 fheisire atá acu sa Pharlaimint, as 577 san iomlán. Fíoraíodh an tairngreacht go dtiocfadh fás ar an bpáirtí, ceal muiníne sna páirtithe bunaithe.
Ní hé sin le rá ar ndóigh gur faisistithe ar fad iad an 35 faoin gcéad den phobal a thabharfadh a gcéad vóta i dtoghchán 2027 do Marine Le Pen, ceannaire an Rassemblement. Páirtí eoraisceipteach agus neamhliobrálach is ea an RN, agus tá taifead coiriúil ag Le Pen as mí-úsáid chistí an Aontas Eorpaigh. Tá sí ar fionraí ó rinneadh achomharc ach í i bpoll coinín dlí dá bharr. Má thoghtar í roimh bhreith na cúirte, beidh díolúine aici agus cumhachtaí an Chúigiú Poblacht ar feadh cúig bliana.
Tá caint áirithe ar na meáin go dtiocfaidh na Gilets Jaunes (na Seaicéid Bhuí) amach arís ar an 17 Deireadh Fómhair i gcoinne phraghas an pheitril.
Maíonn Le Pen go bhfuil sí neamhchiontach, agus tá Jordan Bardella, a comharba polaitiúil, molta aici mar phríomh-aire, é gan mórán taithí oibre ná pholaitiúil. Cáineadh cuairt a thug sé ar Nigel Farage, theip air casadh le Giorgia Meloni le linn dó a bheith san Iodáil ar na mallaibh, agus tá sé faoi imscrúdú as caimiléireacht a dhéanamh le cistí de chuid an Aontas.
Tá an Fhrainc i sáinn i ndáiríre. Mhol beirt Macroniste - atá ar eite chlé pháirtí Macron - comhghuaillíocht leathan chlé-dheas chun seasamh i gcoinne an fhaisisteachais. Seachas páirtí Jean-Luc Mélenchon, La France Insoumise, atá ar an eite chlé radacach, agus páirtí Le Pen, tá páirtithe an láir trína chéile.
Fágadh rian ar pholaitíocht na Fraince in 2002 nuair a chuaigh athair Le Pen, Jean-Marie, FN/RN, chun cinn don dara babhta in áit phríomh-aire na Fraince Lionel Jospin, Páirtí Sóisialach (PS), a rabhthas ag súil leis.
Tá nath cainte sa Ghearmáinis a deir Leben wie Gott in Frankreich (“maireachtáil mar a bheadh Dia ann sa Fhrainc”), ach ina ainneoin sin, níl saol na bhfuíoll sa tír faoi láthair agus reáchtálfar feachtas toghchánaíochta 2027 faoi scáth an mhíshásaimh.
Is ón Front National, páirtí antoisceach seineafóbach ciníoch a bhunaigh baill den Waffen-SS in 1972, a d’eascair an Rassemblement National.
Tá an páirtí ag iarraidh cuma shnasta a chur air féin le tamall ach caitheadh smál air arís le déanaí nuair a taifeadadh ball den pháirtí, garda cuid d’fhórsa slándála Bardella, in Carcassonne agus é ag rá maslaí ciníocha, gnéasaíocha agus homafóbacha. D’aimsigh an nuachtán Mediapart teachtaireachtaí frith-Sheimíteacha le Bardella in 2013, tráth a bhí sé ina ghníomhaí óg sa FN.
Measann tacaithe an pháirtí sin nach bhfuil siad féin chomh saibhir le daoine eile (“ les Autres ”), ach gan bheith chomh bocht le hinimircigh agus daoine de dhath a fhaigheann cúnamh sóisialta. An eacnamaíocht, cúrsaí pinsin agus aeráide, costas maireachtála agus peitril, na fiacha náisiúnta, leimhe na polaitíochta agus cibirionsaithe ar an earnáil phoiblí, cuireann na nithe sin go léir as do vótálaithe i gcoitinne.
Ceapann lucht tacaíochta an RN áfach go bhfuil an tsochaí iarthionsclaíoch anuas orthu, go n-íocann siad an iomarca cánach gan faic a fháil ar ais, nach bhfuil seirbhísí poiblí ar fáil go héasca, ná tithe ar phraghas réasúnta. Ceaptar gurb iad lucht na heite clé boicíní na cathrach, bodaigh mhóra na polaitíochta agus an scothaicme ag a bhfuil céimeanna ollscoile.
I mbliana dódh limistéar d’fhoraoiseacha na Fraince a bhí ar cóimhéid le hachar iomlán Pháirceanna Náisiúnta na hÉireann de bharr tonnta teasa a mhair 52 lá agus ba chúis le bás 8,214 dhuine. Fágadh iarmhairtí sláinte tromchúiseacha fadtéarmacha ar dhaoine, ar nós strócanna agus taomanna croí, riochtaí nach gcabhróidh tráma an fheachtais toghcháin leo.
Cháin cónaitheoirí foirgnimh ardéirí neamhinslithe rialtas Macron tar éis na dtonnta teasa agus gheal Le Pen aerchóiriú do gach éinne - leigheas mór a páirtí ar an athrú aeráide.
Roimh bhua an pháirtí nua-Naitsíoch AfD i Sacsain-Anhalt na Gearmáine an mhí seo caite, páirtí a mbíodh RN gar dó, dúirt Joschka Fischer, iar-leas-sheansailéir na Gearmáine, go raibh tionchar an fhuatha ar ais san Eoraip agus an daonlathas liobrálach maolaithe.
Ní gá, áfach, go spreagfadh toghadh Le Pen réabhlóid macasamhail na sans-culottes in 1789, ach d’fhéadfadh an eite chlé seasamh ina coinne, rud a tharla i stair na Fraince roimhe.
D’fhéadfá a rá go bhfuil éirí amach i gcoinne na Roinne Oideachais ar siúl cheana féin i 10% de mheánscoileanna an stáit agus iad ag agóidiacht i gcoinne drochchúinsí sna scoileanna; tá 400 lycées dúnta, 1,949 dalta gafa ag na póilíní, 305 póilíní agus fir dóiteáin gortaithe, círéibeoirí tarraingthe ón taobh amuigh agus an mhilleán curtha ag an rialtas ar LFI Mélenchon. Tá caint ar na meáin freisin go dtiocfaidh na Gilets Jaunes (na Seaicéid Bhuí) amach arís ar an 17 Deireadh Fómhair i gcoinne phraghas an pheitril.
Tá sciar mór de na vótálaithe neamhchinnte, fiabhrasach agus cloíte, agus tá drogall ar na páirtithe comhoibriú nó aontú.
I rith an tsamhraidh, chaith Gabriel Attal (Renaissance, páirtí Macron) agus Bruno Retailleau (Les Républicains, páirtí coimeádach) anuas ar Édouard Philippe (Horizons, páirtí lárnach deas eile). Chuaigh an bheirt acu sa tóir ar vótálaithe na heite deise freisin - rinne Attal ionsaí ar an Lucht Siúil, agus rinne Retailleau ionsaí ar imircigh. Tá Attal ag feachtasaíocht chun a thaithí pholaitiúil a thaispeáint agus pinsinéirí a mhealladh. An dtacóidh sé le Philippe roimh i bhfad?
“Greannmhar, ach neamhaibí freisin,” a thugann Philippe ar Attal ina leabhar nua.
Bhí Attal, Philippe agus Raphaël Glucksmann (Place Publique, páirtí lárnach clé) faoi ionsaí ag seirbhísí rúnda na Rúise, rud a léiríonn tábhacht an toghcháin go hidirnáisiúnta.
Ar an eite chlé, tá Glucksmann ag mealladh vótálaithe agus ghlac sé páirt i réamhthoghchán an Pháirtí Shóisialaigh. Tá an t-iar-uachtarán François Hollande (PS) i bponc áfach ó dhiúltaigh sé páirt a ghlacadh sa réamhthoghchán céanna. Déanfaidh sé cinneadh um Nollaig.
I mí Lúnasa, agus é ar cuairt ar oileán Mayotte, taobh le Madagascar, léirigh Philippe stuamacht faoin imirce: chun smacht a fháil ar an ngéarchéim imirce, leasódh sé an bunreacht, dá mba ghá, ach le forlámhas an dlí seachas le reifreann, an rogha atá á moladh ag Retailleau agus Bardella araon.
D’fhógair Gérald Darmanin (an tAire Dlí agus Cirt agus iarAire Gnóthaí Baile) go hoifigiúil go raibh sé chun tacaíocht a thabhairt do Édouard Philippe mar iarrthóir uachtaránachta.
Agus páirtithe na heite deise agus na heite clé sa tríú háit, chuaigh François Bayrou, Mouvement Démocrate, páirtí atá ar dheis ón lár, i dteagmháil leis na daonlathaithe sóisialta chun réamhthoghchán leathan a eagrú. Is é an cuspóir atá aige ná iarrthóir aontaithe amháin a roghnú a bheadh inghlactha ag gach dream.
Léirigh pobalbhreith Ipsos go gcáileodh Philippe don dara babhta, dá mbeadh sé ina ionadaí aonair ar lár. Chuir sé tús le feachtas aontaithe a mhairfidh idir seo agus Samhain; dhiúltaigh Attal agus Retailleau, a bhfuil a fheachtas féin marbhánta, dó cheana féin.
Chuir Marine Tondelier, ó na Glasaigh, brú agus d’eagraigh na Sóisialaigh an chéad phlé teilifíse de thrí cinn ar an 23 Meán Fómhair, gan na cumannaigh aonaracha ná La France Insoumise. Tá an iomarca iarrthóirí ann fós agus an t-am ag dul thart.
Tá easpa cur chuige agus éadóchas i measc daonlathaithe; mura n-aontaítear sa lár, beidh an bua sa dara babhta ag Le Pen ar Mélenchon, an bheirt acu antoisceach, deighilteach.
Tá easpa muiníne ag na fostóirí i gcur chuige eacnamaíoch Le Pen, í traidisiúnta, náisiúnaíoch, ar son a vótálaithe féin agus cáinteach ar mhná Moslamacha a chaitheann an chaille. Is é ‘An Fhrainc do na Francaigh’ a mana maidir le tithíocht shóisialta agus obair, í chun cáin bhreisluacha ar pheitreal agus rialacha Rátála Fuinnimh Foirgnimh (BER, mar a thugtar ar a mhacasamhail in Éirinn) a mhaolú. Ar an taobh eile, tá Bardella nua-aoiseach, uirbeach, liobrálach i gcúrsaí eacnamaíocha agus pinsin, agus tá difríochtaí eatarthu i dtaobh na caille agus na hÚcráine.
Ach in am an dóláis tagann dóchas as foinsí daonna nach mbítear ag súil leo.
I rith an tsamhraidh léiríodh díograis de Gaulle i gcoinne na Naitsithe in dhá scannán stairiúla a chonaic sé mhilliún duine. An ann i gcónaí d’acmhainní morálta den sórt sin? An mbeidh an bua ag fórsaí dorcha na 1930idí? Cad a thiocfaidh as seasamh agus caint Macron ainneoin go bhfuil a ráta sástachta ar 20%? Mar a deir an seanfhocal: “Tabhair rogha don bhodach agus tógfaidh sé an díogha”.
Tá cónaí ar Patrick Gormally sa Fhrainc. Comhairleoir baile neamhspleách deonach ab ea é ar feadh 18 mbliana.

title: Jim Bakker: US televangelist, disgraced in fraud and sex scandal, dies at 86
description: Prominent television preacher built a multimillion-dollar empire but was imprisoned for fraud
content:
US televangelist Jim Bakker, who built a multimillion-dollar empire and lived in opulence before being disgraced by a sex scandal, fraud conviction for defrauding followers and divorce from television co-host Tammy Faye, died on Monday at age 86.
The death of Bakker was revealed on social media by his second wife, Lori Bakker
“It is with a broken heart that I share that my beloved husband, Jim ​Bakker, went home to be with the Lord this evening,” she wrote on the Facebook and Instagram pages of her husband’s latest television ministry.
She paid tribute to Bakker as a “pioneer of Christian television”; the cause and circumstances of his death were not revealed.
Bakker’s journey from the TV pulpit to a prison cell in the 1980s inspired comparisons to the corrupt character of the fictional preacher-huckster Elmer Gantry. He revived his career as a television preacher after prison with a new wife and new television show in 2003, later becoming a staunch supporter of president Donald Trump.
Bakker had been among the most popular of the Christian preachers who thrived on ​US television in the 1980s, achieving fame on the show The PTL Club. PTL stood for Praise The Lord and People That Love.
Detractors, pointing to his unabashed daily exhortations to viewers for donations to his ministry, said PTL should have stood for “pass the loot.”
Bakker spent 4½ years in prison after being convicted in Charlotte, ⁠North Carolina, in 1989 of defrauding followers in a scheme involving vacations at his Heritage USA Christian theme park and resort.
Prosecutors painted him as a selfish and petty con man driven by greed and ‌lust ‌for ​power.
“Those of us who do have a religion are sick of being saps for money-grubbing preachers and priests,” judge Robert Potter told Bakker before sentencing him.
Bakker had quit the PTL ministry in 1987 after revelations of a 1980 sexual encounter with Jessica Hahn, a former church secretary who later posed nude in Playboy magazine, and a subsequent $265,000 pay-off with ⁠ministry funds to gain her silence. Bakker was later defrocked.
Jim and Tammy Faye Bakker, his first ​wife, had started with a small TV ministry and eventually created a multimillion-dollar operation with 2,000 employees and the ​930-hectare (​2,300-acre) Heritage USA complex in Fort Mill, South Carolina.
At its peak, the PTL ministry drew 13 million viewers on 200 TV stations and raked in $129 million a year.
With his working-class upbringing, the affable Bakker related well to common folk.
He did not ‌deliver fire-and-brimstone sermons like other televangelists, instead offering a friendly Christian message – although it was infused ​with requests for money donations.
Tammy Faye was more much more flamboyant, with her enthusiastic singing and penchant for tears.
Bakker was convicted after a ⁠six-week trial in federal court on all 24 fraud and conspiracy charges brought against him.
Prosecutors said ⁠he defrauded followers of $158 million by selling promises of lifetime ​annual vacations that he could not provide.
They said he siphoned $3.7 million to bankroll a lavish lifestyle that included several homes, luxury cars, mink coats, diamonds, servants – and an air-conditioned dog house.
The judge ordered Bakker to 45 years in prison but the sentence was later reduced. “I have sinned,” Bakker told the court. “I have made mistakes. But never in my life did I intend to defraud anyone.”
Bakker’s chief aide, Richard Dortch, served 18 months of an eight-year prison sentence after pleading guilty to reduced charges in exchange for testifying against Bakker.
Tammy Faye was never charged. She stood by Bakker at the trial – even singing to reporters after his conviction – but divorced him in 1992 while he was in prison. She died of cancer in 2007.
Bakker started his life over after leaving prison in 1994, renouncing the “prosperity gospel” he once preached and writing a book titled I Was Wrong.
“I’ve had a second chance at life. And I have a beautiful wife who loves me,” Bakker told CNN in 2000, referring to his second wife, Lori, who he married in 1998.
They started a ‌TV ministry together in 2003. In 2008, they began taping The ⁠Jim Bakker Show at a 240-hectare development called Morningside near the tourism city of Branson, Missouri, that bore similarities to Heritage USA.
Bakker once again pleaded with his followers for donations.
In 2020, he drew the ire of state and federal officials for selling a false treatment for Covid-19 during the deadly coronavirus pandemic.
Bakker also said in 2017 that Christians would launch a civil war if Trump were ‌to be impeached. Trump later became the first US president to be impeached twice.
James Orson Bakker was born on January 2nd, 1940, the son of an auto parts factory worker in Muskegon, Michigan, who maintained a strict fundamentalist Christian household.
He met Tammy Faye LaValley at North ​Central Bible College in Minneapolis and they married in 1961. Both dropped out of school to become travelling evangelists as he pursued the career of a minister ​of the Pentecostalist Assemblies of God denomination.
Their big break came in 1964, when televangelist Pat Robertson aired a children’s religious puppet show with them on his fledgling TV network.
Setting out on his own in the 1970s, Bakker used the emerging world of cable and satellite TV to build an empire. – Reuters

title: Iranian drone threat prompted withdrawal of US aircraft from British airbase
description: Officials say bombers were taken from Fairford because of the risk of an attack ordered by Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps
content:
The United States abruptly withdrew all 12 B-1 Air Force bombers from an airbase in southern England based on new information that commanders received about a potential drone attack ordered by Iran ’s Revolutionary Guard, according to US and British officials.
The suspected attack was part of a complex, multipronged Iranian plot to strike aircraft and kill some of the several hundred American personnel stationed at the base, RAF Fairford, the officials said, speaking on the condition of anonymity to discuss operational matters. All of the Air Force bombers were withdrawn over the weekend.
Some of the officials said they believed that the plot was loosely modelled on an audacious attack that Ukraine launched against Russia last year when it smuggled drones deep into the Russian heartland and launched them from trucks. The attack destroyed or damaged at least a dozen aircraft, including many of Moscow’s nuclear-capable strategic bombers, on runways in Siberia and Russia’s Far North.
US vice president JD Vance said on Monday that the Pentagon quickly moved the bombers “out of an abundance of caution trying to protect our guys.” He accused Iran of plotting attacks against the United States but stopped short of commenting on any details about the most recent threat.
“We do feel with some confidence that the Iranians are trying to do what the Iranian state has done for 49 years, which is engage in acts of terrorism against the United States and against a lot of other people as well,” Vance told reporters at Joint Base Andrews before leaving on a trip to Alaska. “We are being extremely cautious.”
US president Donald Trump said Monday that people linked to Iran posed a threat to US bombers at the British airbase, prompting the order to return them to the United States. “There were some threats,” Trump told reporters. “Why should we leave them there?” he added, referring to the bombers.
The Wall Street Journal earlier reported the drone threat as the reason for the withdrawal.
The sudden pullout of the bombers came a week after British police arrested five men who had been travelling the morning of September 27th in white vans near the base, which has been used by US bombers in the US-Israeli war against Iran . The men were released on bail a day later after authorities did not discover explosives in the vans.
But police have repeatedly said the men remain under investigation, and a British-Iranian dual national was arrested on Thursday on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts.
The rushed order to withdraw the bombers was highly unusual. Such moves are rarely made so quickly from an allied airbase in a peacetime country thousands of miles from a combat zone.
Indeed, the need to move the bombers from the base was deemed so urgent that some of the planes and their flight crews left while aerial refuelling aircraft were still being deployed to support their flights to the United States, US officials said.
Many details about the potential threat that prompted the rapid withdrawal of the Air Force bombers, some of which had arrived just in the past week as part of a regular rotation of forces, remained unclear on Monday.
One US official said the new information was part of the same threat warnings that surfaced three weeks ago, though a sense of urgency peaked over the weekend, alarming commanders.
British prime minister Andy Burnham said last week that the British government believed Iran played a part in planning the events that led to the arrests. US and British officials, as well as those in Germany and Israel, believe the operation is connected to Iran’s Revolutionary Guard or a separate military headquarters in Tehran. Iran has denied the accusations.
On Monday, Burnham’s spokesperson declined to comment on other nations’ military operations. Asked whether the airbase was safe, the spokesperson said it was and referred to a statement made last week by the British defence secretary, Wes Streeting, who described “tried and tested approaches to defend our bases around the country and throughout the world.”
Authorities have been puzzled by the bizarre set of events in Fairford over the past week, including the arrests, the frantic evacuation of 85 homes, a bomb-disposal robot searching the vans for explosives and a national security meeting convened by Burnham.
In July, Iran’s Revolutionary Guard issued a statement warning that allowing the United States to use the base “makes London responsible” for US actions. “Any base used to launch attacks on Iranian territory,” the statement said, “is a legitimate target for our forces.”
In mid-September, US military commanders received
a dire warning from US and other western intelligence agencies, according to US officials briefed on the information: RAF Fairford was the target of a potential Iran-backed attack.
After that warning last month, concern among officials across Europe increased. According to a senior US official, Israel warned Germany that US bases there were at heightened risk, noting the Spangdahlem and Ramstein airbases in particular. – This article originally appeared in The New York Times .

title: James O’Neill’s parents meet Minister to discuss circumstances of son’s death and identification
description: Body found in Phoenix Park in November 2023, but father and mother did not learn of death until over a year later
content:
The parents of James O’Neill – the Belfast man whose body was found in the Phoenix Park in November 2023 – who didn’t learn of his death until over a year later say they are still searching for answers regarding their son’s death, following a meeting with the Minister for Justice Jim O’Callaghan .
The Minister met Paul and Ann O’Neill on Monday.
“We’re glad that he met us,” said O’Neill’s father, Paul. “The fact that he took the time to meet us and tell us he was genuinely concerned about what happened, from that perspective, will give you hope that this is being taken really seriously. But we are ‘as you were’.”
[ Man found dead in Phoenix Park unidentified for a year, despite ID in pocket Opens in new window ]
The O’Neill family was not informed of their son’s death for 13 months. His remains were stored as “unidentified” in a Dublin mortuary, despite his name appearing on an initial post-mortem report, and on a CV found close to his body. Gardaí later discounted this name as a false ID.
About a year after his body was discovered, a forensic anthropologist examined his remains and found nine forms of identification in the jacket O’Neill was wearing.
While his parents expressed their appreciation for the Minister meeting them, they said frustrations remain about what they characterise as “long, drawn-out processes” regarding clarity on elements of the Garda investigation, why there was no public appeal made, as well as their concerns about why it took so long to identify the body of their son.
“I feel we’re just in the same situation,” said Ann O’Neill.
The Garda Ombudsman, Fiosrú, is continuing to investigate the actions of gardaí in the case.
At a hearing in the Dublin District Coroner’s Court last month, an inquest into the circumstances surrounding O’Neill’s death was adjourned for six months following a request from a representative of Fiosrú.
“If a review of how these processes and protocols work to ensure nothing like this happens again, then it’s worth it. We wouldn’t wish this on anybody,” said Paul O’Neill.

title: Jeffrey Archer, bestselling ‘storyteller’ and disgraced politician, dies at 86
description: His thrillers sold hundreds of millions of copies worldwide
content:
Jeffrey Archer, a bestselling British author, politician, philanthropist, athlete and one-time jailbird, whose resume seesawed between achievement and disgrace, and who inspired abiding public fascination with headline-grabbing accounts, both fictional and personal, of ambition, self-promotion, misbehaviour and scandal, died on Monday at his home in London. He was 86.
His publisher, HarperCollins, announced his death in a statement. His final novel, Adam and Eve, about the intertwined destinies of the highborn and the humble, was scheduled for publication Tuesday.
Archer’s thrillers and sagas of the rich and powerful sold hundreds of millions of copies worldwide. In his London apartment overlooking the Thames, the walls were adorned with paintings, including works by Claude Monet and Pablo Picasso.
As a host there, he became known for annual parties at which celebrity guests were served top-end Krug Champagne and lowly shepherd’s pie. He also maintained homes in Majorca and in the village of Grantchester outside Cambridge, where he bought the 17th-century Old Vicarage, once the home of poet Rupert Brooke. Routinely, he was reported to borrow the overseas homes of wealthy friends and acquaintances to compose the multiple first drafts of his novels.
In his days as a politician – both as a member of parliament in the elected House of Commons and as deputy head of Margaret Thatcher ’s Conservative Party – he displayed a barely veiled hunger for the top job. His friendships and alliances eventually won him a place in the unelected House of Lords with the title Baron Archer of Weston-super-Mare – his childhood hometown in southwest England.
A political Houdini, he survived many vicissitudes, including a perjury conviction in 2001 when he was found guilty of creating false diaries and concocting a story to win a trial over whether he had slept with a prostitute to whom he paid hush money.
He once said politics was his first choice of career, but it was from his 40-plus books that he amassed wealth, starting with a novel entitled Not a Penny More, Not a Penny Less, published in 1976 after he had been defrauded of his personal fortune and stood down as a lawmaker. “I was so low I would have sold fake Gucci bags on street corners,” he told the Chicago Tribune. “Once you’ve lost a million dollars, you may as well have lost a hundred million dollars.”
A former public relations man, he turned to writing thrillers and found he had an immediate skill for quick action that connected with readers. “Where I come from in the west country, we say ‘Tell ’em a yarn, m’dear, and make ’em keep turning the pages, and you won’t be far wrong,’” he explained.
His first published novel told the story of four men who banded together to defraud a con man who had robbed them of $1 million each. Like the works that were to follow, the novel drew condescending criticism from some writers boasting more elevated literary credentials and less-padded bank accounts. Archer described himself as a storyteller, a qualification which he depicted as unusual and the object of resentment.
“Storytellers are very rare, but they create a lot of envy,” Archer said in an interview with fellow author Anthony Horowitz for The Sunday Telegraph Magazine in 2011. “The people who survive are storytellers.”
The interview evoked some of the ambiguities and passions surrounding Archer’s work, which drew on themes such as power, rivalry, ambition and greed.
“I’m painfully aware that of the two writers in the room only one has an original Monet on the wall,” Horowitz wrote, referring to the location of the interview in his subject’s apartment. He noted that Archer’s 1979 novel Kane and Abel, which sold more than 50 million copies since its publication in 1979, helped fund his art collection.
“I don’t think Jeffrey is deliberately trying to trash me,” Horowitz wrote, “but he does seem to have a strange reflex action that manifests itself as one-upmanship.”
Kane and Abel kindled one of Archer’s recurrent storylines – the rags-to-riches struggle of Abel Rosnovski, born in penury in a forest in Poland, who becomes a wealthy hotelier in the United States and arch-rival to William Kane, born on the same day but thousands of miles away as the scion of a wealthy banking family in New York.
Archer paid particular attention to sales of his books in the United States and went so far as to rewrite some of them specifically for the US market.
According to an unauthorised Archer biography, Stranger Than Fiction (1995), by British journalist Michael Crick, he felt a greater affinity for the showbiz aspects of American public life and once said, “If I was born today and wanted to go into politics, I would want to be born in the United States.”
In later years, though, he vouchsafed a less-flattering view of Americans in remarks that recalled his reputation for gaffes and blunt talking. During the presidential election campaign in 2024 in the United States, for instance, he told The Daily Telegraph he believed Donald Trump would win because “three-quarters of Americans are not intelligent”.
Jeffrey Howard Archer was born in London on April 15th, 1940, and grew up in Weston-super-Mare. His mother was Lola (Cook) Archer, a journalist with a column in a local newspaper and whom he described as largely “penniless”.
Archer gave conflicting accounts of his father, William, whom he sometimes called a “printer”, although by some accounts he was a bigamist and fraudster. Either way, he was not much of a presence in his son’s life and died when Jeffrey was 11.
Archer was educated on a scholarship to a school in the county of Somerset and left with limited qualifications to train with the police and the army. He taught physical education at a school in the southeast and went on in 1963 to study for a diploma in education at the University of Oxford, where he was associated with Brasenose College.
At Oxford, he showed a flair for athletics as a sprinter and hurdler – running for the university and for his country – and for philanthropy, fundraising on behalf of the non-profit Oxfam. A photograph from the era showed him with The Beatles, whose members he had persuaded to endorse a campaign by visiting Brasenose College. The drummer, Ringo Starr, was widely quoted as describing him as “a nice enough fella, but he’s the kind of bloke who would bottle your piss and sell it”. He went on later to raise funds for Iraqi Kurds.
[ ‘Tony O’Reilly should have been president of Ireland’: Jeffrey Archer on life, books and his God-given gift Opens in new window ]
He went into public relations and fundraising and, in 1966, he married an Oxford chemistry undergraduate, Mary Weeden. In addition to his wife, who became a chemistry professor at the University of Cambridge, he is survived by two sons, William and James; and five grandchildren.
Archer began a political career as a Conservative Party member of the Greater London Council from 1967 to 1970. He became one of the youngest lawmakers in the House of Commons in 1969, at age 29, winning a special election for the district of Louth in eastern England.
While a parliamentarian, he was defrauded of a major investment in a Canadian company called Aquablast and emerged with debts of some £500,000, worth millions in buying power at current exchange rates. He stepped down from parliament rather than contest the national elections in 1974.
“I had begun to believe that everything I did was bound to be a success,” he later told The Times of London. “The downfall showed me that I wasn’t a god. I was a normal mortal, well able to make a bloody fool of myself, which I did.”
In 1985, he became deputy chair of the Conservative Party, a high-profile, unelected position. Between the 1980s and the early 2000s, he wrote three stage plays that received uneven notices. Such was his fascination with the stage that, in 1988, he bought a controlling share in a London theatre.
In his books, Archer showed a liking for multivolume series of novels revolving around central characters, such as the seven-book Clifton Chronicles charting the life and times of Harry Clifton, the son of a dockworker in southwest England, and the equally ambitious series of books such as An Eye for an Eye (2024) following the career of a Scotland Yard detective named William Warwick. Even in nonfiction, Archer turned two years spent in prison for perjury into a three-volume memoir called A Prison Diary.
[ 2013 interview with Jeffrey Archer about his time in prison and his success in India: ‘It’s like being a pop star’Opens in new window Opens in new window ]
His jail term had its roots in a case in 1987, when Archer sued the tabloid Daily Star for libel for reporting he had slept with a prostitute, Monica Coghlan. The judge, Bernard Caulfield, described Archer’s wife Mary as having “elegance” and “fragrance” and asked whether the writer would have needed “cold, unloving, rubber-insulated sex in a seedy hotel room”. Archer won the case and was awarded £500,000 in damages.
In 1992, with the support of Conservative backers including Thatcher and then prime minister John Major, he was ennobled as Lord Archer. In 1999, he became the Conservative candidate in elections to choose a mayor of London despite never-proven allegations that he had used insider information in a deal to buy shares in Anglia Television five years earlier.
But before the vote was held, another newspaper, The News of the World, reported allegations that Archer had committed perjury at the original libel trial in 1987, forcing him to withdraw from the mayoral race.
Those charges came to trial in September 2000 and, in July 2001, he was given a four-year jail term for perjury and perverting the course of justice. After two years in a variety of correctional institutions, he was released, resuming his career as a prolific writer. He kept his title and retired from the House of Lords in 2024.
This article originally appeared in The New York Times .

title: Braithfear macallaí Dhroim Crí go ceann i bhfad
description: Tá páirtithe ar nós an TUV ag baint leas as an achrann chun a éileamh go gcuirfí deireadh leis an Fheidhmeannas
content:
Agus an tsáinn ar Bhóthar Garbhachaidh fós ag dul ar aghaidh, tá imní ag méadú nach mairfidh na struchtúir pholaitíochta sa tuaisceart agus go dtiocfaidh deireadh leis an Fheidhmeannas murar féidir teacht ar réiteach.
Tá cinneadh fós le déanamh sa Chúirt Achomhairc i mBéal Feirste maidir leis an iarratas is déanaí atá déanta ag pobal Bhóthar Gharbhachaidh, ach ní dócha gur féidir le haon chinneadh cúirte na dúshláin atá cruthaithe ag an scéal seo a chur ina gceart.
Ón am a fógraíodh cinneadh Choimisiún na Mórshiúlta cead a thabhairt don iarratas ón Ord Oráisteach mórshiúl a reáchtáil ar Bhóthar Garbhachaidh i bPort an Dúnáin, bhí sé ar nós gur cuireadh an dioscúrsa polaitíochta siar chuig na nóchaidí thar oíche, agus na sean-argóintí céanna á dtabhairt amach arís ar cheisteanna a shíl daoine a bhí socraithe beagnach 30 bliain ó shin.
Tá Carla Lockhart, MP de chuid an DUP don cheantar, daingean ina tuairim go mbaineann an cheist seo le dlí agus le hord agus gur chóir don PSNI an mórshiúl a éascú bealach amháin nó eile. Chomh maith leis sin tá sise agus baill eile dá páirtí ag ardú ceisteanna maidir le ról an Chéad-Aire Michelle O’Neill sa léirsiú in éadan na paráide ar an 27 Meán Fómhair. Dúirt an Leas-Chéad Aire Emma Little Pengelly ón DUP go bhfuil “séanadh ceannasaíochta” ar bun ag O’Neill.
…tá damáiste ollmhór déanta don mhuinín atá ag daoine sa chóras polaitíochta ó thuaidh.
Bhí i bhfad níos mó siar agus aniar idir na páirtithe an tseachtain ar fad, le líomhaintí agus maslaí caite ar an dá thaobh. Tá sé soiléir cad a shíleann gach páirtí faoin stad reatha, ach rud nach bhfuil soiléir ná cad é an chéad chéim eile atá rompu mura bhfuil sé i gceist acu an córas ar fad a tharraingt anuas. Cén bealach a dtiocfadh le polaiteoirí filleadh ar ghnáthchaidreamh oibre ina dhiaidh seo ar fad?
Ar ndóigh, níor chóir scigmhagadh a dhéanamh faoi ábhar den chineál seo a bhfuil stair dheacair, thragóideach, throm atá ag baint leis, ach gan aon amhras tá daoine ann a fheiceann buntáiste sa ghéarchéim seo agus deiseanna a mianta a chur chun tosaigh.
Agus toghcháin ag teacht i mí Bealtaine na bliana seo chugainn, tá na feachtais faoi lánseol agus gach polaiteoir ag coinneáil súil amháin ar an lá vótála atá le teacht. Léirigh pobalbhreitheanna le déanaí go bhfuil vóta na bpáirtithe san Fheidhmeannas tite le tamall. Tá an DUPgo háirithe ag streachailt le bliain iontach deacair curtha isteach acu, agus iad imníoch go gcaillfear vótaí chuig an TUV agus UUP. Dar le ceannaire an SDLP Claire Hanna, tá an DUP á stiúradh ag cuid de na gnéithe is antoiscí den dílseachas, agus is cinnte go bhfuil an páirtí ag iarraidh dul i bhfeidhm orthu siúd a bheadh ag dul i dtreo an TUV.
Tá roinnt imreoirí eile atá iontach sásta leas a bhaint as an scéal seo chomh maith chun éileamh a dhéanamh go gcuirfí deireadh leis an Fheidhmeannas, go háirithe uathu siúd nár chreid sna hinstitiúidí déabhlóidithe riamh agus a bhí á gcáineadh le fada an lá. Ní haon rud nua é go bhfuil ceannaire an TUV Jim Allister nó an dílseoir agus ‘comhairleoir dlí’ Jamie Bryson ag éileamh go gcuirfí deireadh leis na hinstitiúidí déabhlóidithe mar gheall nach bhfuil muinín acu iontu, ach ní raibh riamh. Go deimhin, bheadh na glaochanna seo á ndéanamh acu cibé scéal a bheadh sa nuacht, ach agus an Feidhmeannas chomh lag agus tá sé faoi láthair, tá meáchan breise lena gcuid iarratas.
Tá buntáiste áirithe eile do chuid de na polaiteoirí más féidir an scéal seo, nó scéalta eile cosúil leis, a choinneáil i mbéal an phobail go ceann tamall eile. Muna mbaineann na díospóireachtaí acu le ceisteanna faoi mhórshiúlta, cearta cultúrtha, agus ceisteanna eile a mheas daoine a bheith socraithe 30 bliain ó shin, ní bheidh an bhéim chéanna ar ábhair eile. Má tá polaiteoirí, an pobal agus na meáin gnóthach ag labhairt faoi na ceisteanna seo, ní bheidh an t-am ann labhairt faoi ghéarchéim an chostais maireachtála, nó drochstaid Loch nEathach, nó ospidéil atá ar tí druidim nó seirbhísí a chailliúint.
Is cúis bhuíochais é go bhfuil gach rud ag titim amach ar bhealach síochánta. Níor fíoraíodh an imní is measa maidir faoin scéal go dtí seo. Chomh maith leis sin, in ainneoin na drochbhaile atá ar an chóras polaitíochta faoi láthair, níor tháinig glaoch dáiríre go fóill chun deireadh a chur leis an Fheidhmeannas ó aon duine a bhí lánpháirteach sa chumhacht roinnte go dtí seo.
Tá, dar ndóigh, seans ann go dtiocfaidh na hinstitiúidí polaitíochta fríd an ghéarchéim seo agus go mbunófar Feidhmeannas úr i mí Bealtaine. Ach, fiú dá dtarlódh sé sin, tá damáiste ollmhór déanta don mhuinín atá ag daoine sa chóras polaitíochta ó thuaidh. Tá an caidreamh idir cuid de na páirtithe polaitíochta níos measa ná mar a bhí sé le blianta fada, agus tá sé deacair a fheiceáil cén dóigh a dtógfar an iontaoibh sin arís agus gach imreoir chomh diongbháilte ina gcuid tuairimí.
Beidh tuilleadh plé sna cúirteanna an tseachtain seo maidir le mórshiúl Dhroim Crí ach fiú má éiríonn leo socrú a dhéanamh, mothófar na himpleachtaí go ceann i bhfad.

title: Geabaire: uirlis Ghaeilge do pháistí a bhfuil uathachas orthu
description: Na Ceithre hAirde: Geabaire; An Mheitheal Náisiúnta Pleanála Teanga; Buaiteoirí na nGradam Foilsitheoireachta
content:
Tá an chéad uirlis tacaíochta cumarsáide Gaeilge, a d’fhorbair taighdeoirí ABAIR i gColáiste na Tríonóide, Baile Átha Cliath, ar fáil anois. Cuirfidh Geabaire “ar chumas páistí nach labhraíonn, nó páistí a bhfuil teorainn lena gcumas cainte, focail agus abairtí Gaeilge a chumadh, agus a rá amach os ard ag úsáid guthanna sintéiseacha”.
Is ar shiombailí atá leagan amach na huirlise bunaithe agus tá beagnach 7,000 focal agus frása réamhchláraithe sa chóras. Tá na cnaipí ar fad leagtha amach “de réir na ranna cainte, brí na bhfocal, an gaol idir na focail agus feidhm na cumarsáide”, agus tá táib éagsúla agus réimse dathanna ar fáil le cuidiú le páistí teacht ar an fhocal atá uathu.
Tá Geabaire ar cheann de na chéad chórais AAC (cumarsáid bhreisitheach agus mhalartach) a dearadh ón bhonn aníos do mhionteanga san Aontas Eorpach.
Deir Neasa Ní Chiaráin, Ollamh Cúnta le Teicneolaíocht Urlabhra agus Teanga don Ghaeilge i gColáiste na Tríonóide, go “líonann Geabaire bearna ollmhór atá riachtanach do phobal na Gaeilge”.
“Cinntíonn Geabaire gur féidir le leanaí a bhfuil riachtanais chasta chumarsáide acu a bheith rannpháirteach ón gcéad lá ar a dturas oideachais. Agus an teicneolaíocht ag forbairt, caithfimid a chinntiú nach bhfágtar cuid de na baill is leochaillí de phobal na Gaeilge taobh thiar. Sampla cumhachtach atá ann den taighde ag teacht le chéile le nuálaíocht theicneolaíoch ar mhaithe le héifeacht dhearfach ar an tsochaí agus ar chearta teanga”.
Tá Geabaire á mhaoiniú ag An Chomhairle um Oideachas Gaeltachta agus Gaelscolaíochta (COGG).
An Mheitheal Náisiúnta Pleanála Teanga ag iarraidh go gcuirfear feabhas ar choinníollacha oibre s’acu
Tá trí phríomhéileamh á lorg ag an Mheitheal Náisiúnta Pleanála Teanga le go mbeidh “córas níos cothroime agus níos inbhuanaithe” acu ina gcuid oibre, chomh maith le “cur chuige níos comhtháite agus níos fadtéarmaí” i leith na pleanála teanga amach anseo. Is é an grúpa neamhspleách seo a dhéanann ionadaíocht ar na ceantracha fud fad na tíre a bhíonn ag plé le cúrsaí pleanála teanga ar bhonn áitiúil agus é mar aidhm acu úsáid na Gaeilge a neartú sa phobal.
Tháinig oifigigh pleanála teanga agus oifigigh forbartha le chéile ag cruinniú i mí an Mheithimh le deiseanna agus dúshláin a phlé agus is ag an chruinniú sin a aontaíodh na trí mhóréileamh.
Deir an Mheitheal go bhfuil “imní láidir” ann faoi na “difríochtaí móra i gcoinníollacha fostaíochta, pá, pinsin agus conarthaí ar fud na hearnála”, agus mar sin go bhfuil siad ag iarraidh scálaí pá “cearta”, “coinníollacha caighdeánaithe atá ar comhchéim leis an tSeirbhís Phoiblí” agus “treoir shoiléir maidir le pinsin, róil agus struchtúir fostaíochta”. Chomh maith leis sin, tá siad ag iarraidh go mbeidh conarthaí níos fadtéarmaí acu agus “cinnteacht go bhfuil Ceanneagraíochtaí Pleanála Teanga dá gcuid i bhfeidhm mar is ceart”.
Tá an Mheitheal ag iarraidh “infheistíocht mhéadaithe” sa phleanáil teanga agus sna grúpaí pobail chomh maith le maoiniú ar leith do chostais reatha na foirne, cosúil le pá, pinsin agus cíos. Teastaíonn plean infheistíochta fadtéarmach don earnáil uathu fosta, a bheadh ag teacht le Plean Fáis Chonradh na Gaeilge.
Ar deireadh, deir an Mheitheal go bhfuil siad ag iarraidh tacaíocht straitéiseach don phleanáil teanga le cuidiú leo “comhoibriú, oiliúint agus dea-chleachtas a chur chun cinn”. Molann siad Lárionad Náisiúnta Pleanála Teanga a bhunú, oiliúint agus forbairt ghairmiúil leanúnach a chur ar fáil d’Oifigigh Pleanála Teanga agus d’fhostaithe nua, chomh maith le comhoibriú gníomhach leanúnach idir Foras na Gaeilge, Údarás na Gaeltachta, Roinn na Gaeltachta, agus an Mheitheal féin.
Dúirt Bairbre Uí Chathail, Comhordaitheoir Pleanála Teanga le Líonra Leitir Ceanainn agus ball de ghrúpa oibre na Meithle Náisiúnta Pleanála Teanga, go bhfuil “pobail ar fud na tíre ag déanamh obair ríthábhachtach ar son na Gaeilge. Le go mbeidh an obair sin inbhuanaithe, áfach, ní mór dúinn a chinntiú go bhfuil na daoine atá ag obair san earnáil ag fáil na gcoinníollacha cearta, go bhfuil maoiniú fadtéarmach ar fáil, agus go bhfuil struchtúr náisiúnta láidir ann chun tacú leo.
“Táimid ag iarraidh cur chuige comhordaithe, uaillmhianach agus fadtéarmach. Tá sé in am pleanáil a dhéanamh don earnáil féin, ar an bhealach céanna a bhfuiltear ag iarraidh ar na pobail pleanáil a dhéanamh do thodhchaí na Gaeilge.”
Buaiteoirí na nGradam Foilsitheoireachta 2026 fógartha
Bhailigh slua d’fhoilsitheoirí agus scríbhneoirí Gaeilge i dTaibhdhearc na Gaillimhe Dé Céadaoin seo caite, áit a raibh ócáid mhór cheiliúrtha ar siúl do Ghradaim Foilsitheoireachta an Oireachtais 2026 i gcomhpháirt le Foras na Gaeilge.
Naoi leabhar déag a bhí ainmnithe ar na gearrliostaí i mbliana agus ba í Áine Ní Ghlinn, Uachtarán an Oireachtais, a bhronn na gradaim ar na buaiteoirí.
Bronnadh Gradam Uí Shúilleabháin, gradam a bhronntar ar Leabhar na Bliana do Dhaoine Fásta gach bliain, ar Maith Thú a Mhicí , leabhar scéalta a scríobh Micí Sheáin Néill Ó Baoill agus a d’fhoilsigh an teach foilsitheoireachta Éabhlóid.
Bronnadh Gradam Réics Carló, gradam Leabhar na Bliana do Pháistí, ar Puisín na mBróg le Fearghas Mac Lochlainn, maisithe ag Paddy Donnelly agus foilsithe ag Futa Fata.
Bronntar Gradam de Bhaldraithe ar shaothar aistrithe go Gaeilge ó theanga eile gach bliain agus is é An Saol Sona , aistriúchán den úrscéal Fraincise La Vie Heureuse le David Foenkinos, a bhain an gradam i mbliana. Is í Máirín Ní Mhárta a d’aistrigh An Saol Sona agus Barzaz a d’fhoilsigh.
Ag labhairt di ag an ócáid, dúirt Máirín Nic Dhonnchadha, Ceannasaí an Oireachtais: “Tréaslaím ó chroí le Éabhlóid, Futa Fata agus Barzaz as na héachtaí atá bainte amach acu i mbliana. Anocht, déanaimid ceiliúradh ní hamháin ar na buaiteoirí ach ar gach uile údar, aistritheoir, maisitheoir agus foilsitheoir as an obair iontach atá ar siúl acu ar fad i gcothú agus i bhforbairt ár dtraidisiúin liteartha. Is léiriú iad na gradaim seo ar an gcruthaitheacht, ar an éagsúlacht agus ar an saibhreas atá ar fáil in earnáil na foilsitheoireachta Gaeilge faoi láthair.”

title: Fadhb fós gan fuascailt
description: Tá tacaíocht léirithe ag na mílte le muintir Bhóthar Gharbhachaidh ach níl aon réiteach ar an tsáinn go fóill
content:
Breithiúnas forchoimeádta a fógraíodh inné ar an chéad lá de chás sa Chúirt Achomhairc i mBéal Feirste le rialú a thabhairt ar iarratas eile ó mhuintir Bhóthar Gharbhachaidh. Dúirt an Príomh-Bhreitheamh, an Bantiarna Siobhán Keegan, go raibh súil aici cinneadh a thabhairt ar an chás laistigh d’achar ama tapa ach nach raibh sí in ann dáta a thabhairt. Bhí sluaite lasmuigh de na cúirteanna chun tacaíocht a léiriú do chónaitheoirí Bhóthar Gharbhachaidh agus an cás cúirte is déanaí á thógáil acu faoi pharáid Dhroim Crí.
Is é bunús an iarratais ná go ndeachaigh Coimisiún na Mórshiúlta amú nuair a ghlac siad le comhairle ón PSNI nach raibh fáth le bheith ag súil le constaicí dá mbronnfaí cead ar an Ord Oráisteach dul ar aghaidh leis an mhórshiúl. Dar leo, ba chóir go mbeadh an Coimisiún ar an eolas nár cheart cead a bhronnadh sa chás seo mar gheall ar stair áirithe an cheantair, agus ar na céadta iarratas atá diúltaithe acu don mhórshiúl go dtí seo. Má ghlactar leis an argóint seo, seans go gcuirfear cinneadh Choimisiún na Mórshiúlta ar ceal agus nach mbeidh cead ann don mhórshiúl a thuilleadh.
Bhí breis agus ceithre uair an chloig d’argóintí dlí cloiste inné, ach cibé rud a thiteann amach sna cúirteanna beidh fós tuilleadh deacrachtaí le socrú ar an talamh.
Tháinig cainteanna chun deiridh an tseachtain seo caite gan réiteach ar bith déanta ar an tsáinn atá fós ar siúl ar Bhóthar Gharbhachaidh i bPort an Dúnáin. Chaith Státrúnaí Thuaisceart Éireann Chris Bryant roinnt laethanta ag plé le hionadaithe ó phobal Bhóthar Gharbhachaidh agus ón Ord Oráisteach araon, ach in ainneoin na n-iarrachtaí tá an dá thaobh chomh daingean ina seasamh agus a bhí riamh.
Is i gCaisleán Chromghlinne, Contae an Dúin, a reáchtáladh na cainteanna i ndiaidh don leamhsháinn a thosaigh ar an 27 Meán Fómhair nuair a chuir pobal Bhóthar Gharbhachaidh agus a lucht tacaíochta bac ar bhaill den Ord Oráisteach siúl trína gceantar ó Dhroim Crí, cé go raibh an pharáid ceadaithe ag Coimisiún na Mórshiúlta den chéad uair le 28 mbliana anuas. Fiú agus srianta curtha ar líon na rannpháitithe agus ar cheol lena linn, baineadh geit as go leor daoine gur ceadaíodh an mórshiúl i bhfianaise na staire fada tragóidí a bhaineann leis.
Bhí splanc dhóchais ann i lár na seachtaine seo caite nuair a d’eisigh urlabhraí de chuid mhuintir Bhóthar Gharbhachaidh Breandán Mac Cionnaith ráiteas lena rá go raibh tairiscint ar an tábla a bheadh pobal an bhóthair sásta glacadh leis dá mbeadh an tOrd Oráisteach toilteanach chomh maith. Níor ghlac an tOrd leis an tairiscint áfach.
Le linn na gcainteanna chuir an tOrd Oráisteach i bPort an Dúnáin moladh chun tosaigh go mbeadh mórshiúl amháin acu ar Bhóthar Gharbhachaidh, agus nach ndéanfaí iarratas ar bith eile ar shiúl ar an bhóthar sin arís. Níor glacadh leis an mholadh seo mar gheall gurb é an t-éileamh atá ag cónaitheoirí Bhóthar Gharbhachaidh ná nach mbeadh paráid Oráisteach ar bith ar an bhóthar.
Cé go bhfuil deireadh tagtha leis an bhabhta seo de chainteanna, tá fós go leor iarrachtaí ag dul ar aghaidh chun teacht ar réiteach.
Thar an deireadh seachtaine tháinig na sluaite amach chun tacaíocht a léiriú don dá sheasamh. Ar an dea-uair, in ainneoin an lín aird daoine a bhí ar na sráideanna agus an teannais a d’eascair ón 27 Meán Fómhair nuair a cuireadh tús leis an tsáinn ar an bhóthar, ní raibh foréigean ar bith ann. Go deimhin, is dea-atmaisféar a bhí le mothú ar Bhóthar Gharbhachaidh féin agus ceoltóirí aitheanta ar nós Beoga, The Mary Whallopers agus Kneecap i measc na mílte a tháinig chun dlúthpháirtíocht a léiriú do na cónaitheoirí.
Ar an taobh dílseach, in Edgarstown i bPort an Dúnáin, reáchtáladh imeacht dar teideal Let Them Home le cainteoirí ón DUP, ón TUV agus ó Jamie Bryson, dílseoir aitheanta atá ainmnithe mar ‘chomhairleoir dlí’ ag an Ord Oráisteach. Rinneadh cáineadh géar ar cheannasaí an PSNI Jon Boucher agus ar an Státrúnaí Chris Bryant araon. Dúradh gur chóir don PSNI an mórshiúl a éascú, agus mura dtarlaíonn sé gur chóir deireadh a chur leis an Fheidhmeannas reatha.
Ar an Déardaoin seo caite dúradh leis an Bhord Póilíneachta go raibh suas le £3 mhilliúin caite ar chostais phóilíneachta go dtí sin. Agus láithreacht an PSNI ag leanúint go tréan ó shin, beidh an costas sin imithe in airde ag am atá an tseirbhís faoi bhrú cheana féin ó thaobh airgeadais de.
Tá an tsáinn seo ina bagairt ollmhór don phróiseas polaitíochta sa Tuaisceart chomh maith, agus baol réadúil ann go bhféadfadh sé tarlú go dtiocfadh an Feidhmeannas chun deiridh mar gheall ar an chonspóid.. Tá na páirtithe polaitíochta leabaithe ina gcuid tuairimí go fóill agus gan aon chuma ar an scéal gur féidir le haon dream réiteach a mholadh a bheadh inghlactha ag an taobh eile.

title: Oil steadies as Persian Gulf exports rise
description: Price cut by Saudi Arabia points to looser market
content:
Oil steadied after losing about 2 per cent on Monday, as rising Persian Gulf exports and a price cut by Saudi Arabia pointed to a looser market.
Global benchmark Brent traded little changed near $101 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate steadied below $90. Gulf producers are moving larger volumes through the Strait of Hormuz, with more tankers taking the risk of navigating the contested waterway despite still-elevated risks.
Kuwait said it is pumping oil about 75 per cent of the level seen before the Iran war, while Iraq is seeking to hire additional vessels to send its cargoes through Hormuz. The moves come as Saudi Aramco cut the price of its flagship Arab Light grade for Asian buyers to a six-year low to push for market share.
Brent remains about 65 per cent higher this year after the US and Israel attacked Iran in February, disrupting supplies and fueling inflation. While oil flows from the Middle East have rebounded toward pre-conflict levels, product markets remain particularly constrained, in part due to Ukrainian strikes on Russia. That’s prompted the Group of Seven and partners to add to stockpile releases.
In Yemen, Saudi-backed forces seized the Red Sea city of Mocha from Iranian-backed Houthis as they push toward the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint, a key maritime route for Saudi exports. In recent months, the Houthi escalations against Riyadh have damaged energy infrastructure and tankers.
Although recovering flows, the Saudi Arabian price cuts and emergency stockpile releases are weighing on crude, escalating fighting in Yemen and risks of further attacks are limiting declines, according to Naohiro Niimura, a partner at energy consultancy firm Market Risk Advisory Co.
“Concerns on supply persist, making it difficult for the market to hold short positions for long,” he said, referring to wagers on losses.
Later Tuesday, the US Energy Information Administration is due to release its short-term energy outlook, including expectations for fuels over the Northern Hemisphere winter. The perspective will provide insights into diesel and heating-oil conditions at a time of acute market stress and record prices.
On fuels, US president Donald Trump eased restrictions on tax-exempt dyed diesel in a bid to lower costs. The long-expected move — which came ahead of midterm elections next month — allows wider use of the product.
“You have to wonder if the Iranians will try to take advantage of the period leading up to the midterm elections,” Robert Yawger, director of the energy-futures division at Mizuho Securities, wrote in a note. “The situation is fraught with danger, and high energy prices are the price to be paid.” - Bloomberg

title: Cancer rates rising more quickly among younger people, international study finds
description: Experts say figures reflect the growing global obesity epidemic, poor diets and insufficient exercise
content:
Cases of many types of cancer have risen sharply among younger people, major new research has found, prompting warnings that lifestyle choices are costing thousands of lives each year.
Analysis of English, US and Dutch cancer data by World Cancer Research Fund identified “significant increases” in early onset cancers for seven cancer types in England, five types in the US and four in the Netherlands.
Although cancer has been increasing across all age groups globally, the rate rise in early onset cases is greater than other ages.
Experts said the figures reflected the growing global obesity epidemic, poor diets and insufficient exercise, as well as growing awareness of cancer and earlier diagnosis.
Cancer among the under 50s is still uncommon, with the median age at diagnosis above 60, but the trend is worrying, the authors noted.
The number of people under 50 diagnosed with prostate cancer in England has quadrupled since 2001, while early onset bowel, kidney and uterine cancer diagnoses more than doubled.
Mark Lawler, professor of digital health and the chair in translational cancer genomics at Queen’s University Belfast, called the problem “a ticking time bomb that we need to diffuse as quickly as possible, otherwise the numbers will undoubtedly continue to grow”.
He added: “The overall trend is also particularly worrying as it comes on the backdrop of lifestyle factors contributing to thousands of deaths.”
In England, of the 12 tumour types studied, incidence rates of prostate cancer among men under 50 jumped from one in every 100,000 people in 2001 to 3.6 in every 100,000 in 2023.
Over the same period, rates of bowel cancer among the under 50s leapt from 3.9 in 100,000 people in 2001 to 8.4 in 100,000 in 2023, while early onset uterine and kidney cancers also doubled to 3.9 and 3 per 100,000 people respectively.
The rate of breast cancer among the under 50s increased, albeit less sharply, from 42 to 47.5 per 100,000 in 2023, while there were also increases in the incidence of early onset pancreatic and liver cancers.
In the US, analysis of official data since 2000 found that among patients under 50, incidence rates of kidney cancer more than doubled from 2.5 in 100,000 people in 2000 to 5.3 in 2023, while bowel, uterine and pancreatic cancers all increased by more than 50 per cent and breast cancer by about 20 per cent.
For the Netherlands, the researchers found significant increases in early onset bowel, kidney, liver and cervical cancers.
In contrast, rates of lung cancer among the under 50s declined in all three countries, reflecting continuing declines in smoking in those countries.
Dr Giota Mitrou, the executive director of research and policy at the World Cancer Research Fund (WCRF), called the trajectory concerning.
“Behind every figure is a person facing cancer earlier than they, their family and often their doctor would expect. While cancer is still much more common in older adults, these changing patterns among younger generations need to be treated as a serious research and cancer prevention priority,” said Mitrou.
The fund said risk factors such as growing obesity levels, poor diet, insufficient exercise, alcohol consumption, smoking and environmental exposures (such as pollutants, chemicals, plastics, water and air pollution) could be contributing to the trend.
About 40 per cent of cancers are linked to these kinds of modifiable risks. However, greater awareness of cancer symptoms also means that people are more likely to be diagnosed earlier. – Guardian

title: “Bhíos faoi gheasa ag éisteacht leis na guthanna neamhshaolta sin ag canadh cheol na mara.”
description: Is amhránaí í Méav Ní Mhaolchatha atá ina ball bunaithe de Celtic Women.
content:
Cad é an chéad phíosa ealaíne is mó a d’imir tionchar ort mar dhéagóir?
Ceirnín le ceol Claude Debussy a bhí ag m’athair agus a chuaigh go mór i bhfeidhm orm. Sa tríú gluaiseacht ó Nocturnes, Sirènes, canann seisear ban déag gan liricí in éineacht leis an gceolfhoireann. Bhíos faoi gheasa ag éisteacht leis na guthanna neamhshaolta sin ag canadh cheol na mara.
Mura mbeifeá ag gabháil don ealaín atá á cleachtadh agat faoi láthair, cén talamh chruthaitheach ba bhreá leat a fhiosrú?
Bá bhreá liom úrscéalta a scríobh. Tá an-mheas agam ar scríbhneoirí a chruthaíonn domhain iomlána agus ina mbíonn an léitheoir go hiomlán sáite sa scéal.
Cén t-éacht gairmiúil is mó a bhfuil tú bródúil as?
Táim bródúil as mo theanga dhúchais a roinnt le lucht éisteachta ar fud an domhain. Is aoibhinn liom amhráin i nGaeilge a mhúineadh do cheoltóirí thar lear agus ceolchoirmeacha a chur ar siúl leo. Bhí deis agam cúpla ceolchoirm mar sin a chur ar siúl in Québec tamall ó shin, agus táim ag súil le filleadh ar Cheanada an bhliain seo chugainn.
Caithfidh tú cónaí i mbuncar faoi thalamh, agus is féidir leat scannán amháin, sraith theilifíse amháin, agus leabhar amháin a thabhairt leat: cad iad?
Roghnóinn An Cailín Ciúin, mar is í m’iníon is óige an príomhaisteoir sa scannán agus bheadh mé uaigneach sa bhuncar gan mo chlann. Bheadh sé go deas na radharcanna lán le solas agus nádúr a fheiscint agus mé faoi thalamh. Is dócha go dtabharfainn sraith theilifíse ghreannmhar liom, b’fhéidir Call my Agent/Dix Pour Cent ionas go mbeadh mé ag gáire agus ag foghlaim Fraincise ag an am céanna. Tá sé deacair leabhar amháin a roghnú, ach bheadh leabhar mór gearrscéalta ó go leor scríbhneoirí éagsúla spéisiúil.
…bhí ár lóistín in ‘óstán grá’, é maisithe ar nós seanchaisleán gruama, agus chaith an bainisteoir níos mó ama thíos sa siléar ag canadh karaoke leis féin ná ag tabhairt aire don óstán.
An raibh aon mhúinteoirí inspioráideacha agat?
D’fhoghlaim mé go leor mar gheall ar scríobh do ghuthanna ón gcumadóir Colin Mawby, cé nár mhúin sé mé go hoifigiúil. Bhí mé mar bhall den chór náisiúnta Chamber Choir Ireland agus bhí Colin ina phríomhstiúrthóir. Cúpla bliain níos déanaí, chuir sé glaoch orm toisc gur chuala sé amhrán a scríobh mé ar an raidió. Cé go raibh sé éirithe as an bpost mar stiúrthóir le fada ag an am sin, stop sé ag tiomáint chun tréaslú liom agus chun mé a spreagadh le leanúint ar aghaidh. Fear cineálta, cneasta a bhí ann agus ceoltóir den scoth, agus thug sé tacaíocht ollmhór dos na hamhránaithe go léir sa chór mar cheoltóirí agus mar dhaoine.
Conas a bhí do shaol cultúrtha mar pháiste?
Cigire ab ea m’athair agus múinteoir mo mháthair, agus bhí an-suim acu i gcúrsaí ealaíne. Cheap mo mhamó go raibh mo dheartháir róchúthaileach, agus dá bhrí sin, seoladh Oisín chuig ranganna drámaíochta. D’éirigh go geal leis agus bhí sé ag aisteoireacht ar stáitse Amharclann na Mainistreach sa dráma The Field agus é fós ina ghasúr óg. Sheinn sé an fhliúit agus sheinn mise an pianó agus an chruit. Cumadóir amaitéarach ab ea m’athair, agus is minic go mbeadh an bheirt againn ag casadh ceoil go déanach san oíche, agus mo mháthair bocht ag déanamh iarracht a dhul a chodladh thuas staighre.
Dá mbeadh sé ar do chumas taisteal siar tríd an am agus tú féin a thabhairt ar ais chuig ceolchoirm amháin ar ar fhreastail tú cheana, cén ceann a roghnófá, agus cén fáth?
Ba bhreá liom filleadh ar cheolchoirm a bhí mar chuid den fhéile Meltdown i Londain in 1995, féile ar a raibh Elvis Costello ina stiúrthóir. Chan Jeff Buckley an oíche sin agus bhí sé dochreidte. Chan sé Grace gan bhanna, leis an ngiotár amháin, ach líon sé an halla le fuaim. Chan sé an píosa clasaiceach Dido’s Lament chomh maith – is aoibhinn liom an t-amhrán sin, agus tá leagan nua cóirithe agam ar an albam Sweet Sorrow. Chan Jeff ar nós aingeal fiáin. Ar ndóigh, ní raibh a fhios againn ansin nach raibh mórán ama fágtha ar an saol seo aige.
Cad a cheapann tú faoi chaighdeán na n-ealaíon in Éirinn faoi láthair?
Ceapaim go bhfuil tobar domhain tallainne anseo in Éirinn, idir cheoltóirí, aisteoirí, scríbhneoirí agus ealaíontóirí. Ní mór dúinn níos mó tacaíocht phraiticiúil a thabhairt dóibh. Mar shampla, deireann an cumadóir Michael Gallen gur athraigh a shaol go hiomlán le teacht an Ioncaim Bhunúsaigh do na hEalaíona. Anois tá duais idirnáisiúnta mór le rá FEDORA buaite aige, agus tá go leor ceoltóirí ag obair in éineacht leis ar cheoldráma a nascann seantraidisiúin na tíre leis an gceol nua-aimseartha.
Roghnóinn An Cailín Ciúin, mar is í m’iníon is óige an príomhaisteoir sa scannán agus bheadh mé uaigneach sa bhuncar gan mo chlann.
Cad é an comhthéacs is aistí ina raibh tú de bharr do chuid oibre?
Fuaireas cuireadh canadh ag féile idirnáisiúnta ceoil faoin tuath sa Chóiré le linn Cheiliúradh Chorn Domhanda an tSacair. D’éirigh go geal linn ag an gceolchoirm, ach bhí ár lóistín in ‘óstán grá’, é maisithe ar nós seanchaisleán gruama, agus chaith an bainisteoir níos mó ama thíos sa siléar ag canadh karaoke leis féin ná ag tabhairt aire don óstán. Bhí Colm Ó Snodaigh sa bhanna s’againne, agus d’eagraigh sé cluiche peile idir na ceoltóirí Éireannacha agus muintir na Cóiré in gcoinne ceoltóirí ón gcuid eile den domhain. Bhuamar!
Cad é an mhíthuiscint is mó atá ag daoine faoi do shaol mar ealaíontóir?
Síltear go mbíonn go leor ama á chaitheamh againn ag cruthú, ag seinnt agus ag canadh, ach dáiríre tá ana-chuid riaracháin ag baint leis freisin. Ach nílim ag olagón! Tuigim go bhfuil an t-ádh orm.
Tá albam nua Méav Ní Mhaolchatha, Sweet Sorrow, amuigh ar an 23ú, agus ceolchoirm sa Royal Irish Academy of Music i mBaile Átha Cliath ar 24ú.

title: A shift right for Brazil will damage its role as counterweight to the US on global issues
description: Right-wing senator Flávio Bolsonaro is the favourite to win election runoff with incumbent president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
content:
A shift to the right in Brazil will boost Donald Trump ’s ambitions in Latin America but is unlikely to diminish China ’s economic influence. Its bigger geopolitical impact could be elsewhere.
Sunday’s first round of voting in Brazil’s presidential election has left right-wing senator Flávio Bolsonaro the favourite in an ideologically charged runoff with incumbent president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. They have different visions for Brazil’s foreign policy, particularly its relationships with the United States and China, and its role as a leader in the Global South and within multilateral institutions.
A Bolsonaro victory would move Brazil closer to Washington, following Chile, Bolivia, Ecuador, Peru and Colombia in a shift to the right and into compliance with Trump’s campaign for US dominance over the western hemisphere. Under Lula, Brazil has been one of a handful of countries in the region that have not joined Trump’s Shield of the Americas, a pact to deploy military forces against transnational drug cartels.
Bolsonaro has promised to designate the cartels as terrorist organisations, offering a legal justification for the deployment of US forces against them on Brazilian territory. And he has made clear that he wants to prioritise the relationship with Washington while taking a more sceptical approach to Beijing.
But while the US and China are engaged in a contest for influence, economic power and access to raw materials throughout Latin America, shifts to the right in countries such as Chile and Brazil have not seen a weakening of China’s position. And although Bolsonaro’s father Jair talked tough about China before becoming president in 2019, he went to Beijing soon after taking office and trade between the two countries grew during his presidency.
The economic relationship is now even more important, with China importing almost 30 per cent of Brazil’s exports and investing more than $6 billion in the country last year. A Bolsonaro victory is unlikely to cause much disruption to trade and investment and Beijing is relaxed about the ideological complexion of its economic partners.
A bigger consequence of a shift to the right could be the abdication of Brazil’s role as a leading advocate for multilateral institutions like the United Nations and for global standards and common action on everything from climate change to artificial intelligence. As a powerful democratic voice in the Global South, Brazil has shown moral leadership and clarity in its willingness to condemn illegal acts of aggression whether they are by the US in Iran, Russia in Ukraine or Israel in Gaza.
A founding member of the Brics in 2009, along with China, Russia and India (South Africa joined in 2011), Brazil has been at the forefront of efforts to build a counterweight to the US-dominated international order. But under successive leaders, including Lula, it has sought to maintain, strengthen and reform existing multilateral institutions rather than to overturn or replace them.
A Bolsonaro victory in Brazil would weaken the international resistance to Trump’s coercive diplomacy and his rapacious appetite for the oil, gas, minerals and other natural resources of his neighbours and allies. That should be a cause for anxiety among other democratic middle powers in Canada, the European Union and throughout the world.
